images.title: T-shirt — tiger front (mannequin + tag)
images.prompt: Front view of a crisp white cotton crew-neck t-shirt fitted on a smooth beige tailor's mannequin torso with a wooden neck stand visible. The shirt has a small chest pocket on the right chest. Just above the pocket, an embroidered orange-and-black tiger head emblem the size of the pocket itself, around 4cm tall, sharply detailed thread texture, the brand identity of the shirt. A clearly visible white paper retail hangtag dangles from a thin natural-string loop attached to the inside of the neckline, falling forward over the upper left chest. The hangtag is rectangular, about 4cm by 7cm, and has its own printed branding: a stylized geometric monogram in dark grey at the top (a simple shape, not the tiger), the brand wordmark in a small serif below it, and the price "$29" in clean sans-serif at the bottom. Both logos must be sharply readable: the embroidered tiger on the chest AND the printed monogram on the hangtag. Plain warm-grey seamless studio backdrop, soft even studio lighting, gentle shadow under the mannequin base. Photoreal e-commerce ghost-mannequin photography, ultra-detailed fabric weave, no people, 3:4 portrait framing.

images.title: Adidas Samba — on-foot with hangtag
images.prompt: Photoreal editorial product photograph of an Adidas Samba OG sneaker worn on a person's right foot, three-quarter view from a slight low angle. The shoe is the classic colorway: white leather upper, black leather T-toe overlay and three-stripes on the lateral side, white "adidas" wordmark above the stripes, gum rubber outsole. A paper retail hangtag with the Adidas trefoil printed on cream cardstock dangles from the top eyelet of the laces on a thin twine loop, clearly visible in frame, catching soft light. The model wears cropped grey trousers; only the lower leg from mid-shin down is visible, no socks. Set: muted warm-grey seamless paper backdrop, soft key light from camera-left, gentle floor contact shadow. Sharp focus on the shoe, especially the three-stripes and the hangtag. Editorial product photography, true colors, no extra text or graphics in frame. 4:5 portrait framing.
